name: Arma 3
description: The military sandbox simulator. Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous); a basic server.cfg is generated at install.

variables.label: Game port (UDP)
variables.description: Arma 3 uses this port plus the three following ones (default 2302-2306).

notes: server.cfg is written at install with the panel variables — re-run install or edit it directly to change advanced options. Open UDP ports 2302-2306 (game, Steam query, Steam master, BattlEye). Load mods with -mod=@mod1;@mod2 (workshop content must be installed separately). Windows hosts: set the start command override to arma3server_x64.exe with the same arguments.
